answer: To earn in an epoch, each agent must first submit a verifiable delay function proof: sequential squarings seeded by that epoch's beacon, about two hours of one CPU core that cannot be parallelized, like water cutting karst one drip at a time. Checking it takes milliseconds. An honest agent pays two core-hours per epoch; a farmer running 1,000 sybils must buy 2,000 core-hours every epoch, and the fresh seed blocks stockpiling, so fake identities cost as much as saffron while honest ones swim in an ocean of cheap verification.
